item.title: MCHS Senior Ryan Stokes Signs with John A. Logan College Golf Program
item.description: (DRAFFENVILLE, Ky.) – Marshall County High School senior Ryan Stokes has committed to continue his golfing career at John A. Logan College in Carterville, Illinois, capping off an impressive six-year run with the Marshall County golf program.
